data.description:
ResearchGate is the professional network for scientists and researchers. From climate change and emerging diseases to food security and the responsible development of AI, the challenges facing our world are complex. Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community.

We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.


Objective of the role

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.

data.title: FP&A Manager
data.description:
About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $15M ARR, with a 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our new New York office.

About the role

We're looking for a FP&A Manager to join as the analytical backbone of our Finance team. This is a strategic finance role: you'll own the financial model, run forecasting cycles, define the KPI framework, and produce the dashboards and finance packs that leadership and the board use to steer the business. Working alongside the Head of Finance, you'll partner with commercial leads on budget ownership and spend decisions, support investor reporting and fundraising, and collaborate with our Business Systems Lead to shape the data infrastructure. data.title: Head of Financial Systems Transformation
data.description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:  

Taxfix is going AI-first with full speed - and Finance at Taxfix is leading by example: We are looking for an expert professional who will be leading both the transformation of financial processes and implementation of AI in the Taxfix financial systems infrastructure. The focus is on improving our core operational finance processes further through automation and best-in-class practices - and to keep evolving them as AI reshapes what's possible both inside and outside our company and its AI-native platform.

data.title: E-Commerce Manager (m/w/d)
data.description:
Bei AYLASHES dreht sich alles um Beauty-Produkte für zu Hause. Für unseren Onlineshop und unsere nächsten Projekte suchen wir jemanden, der gerne organisiert, eigene Ideen einbringt und Dinge zuverlässig umsetzt.

Du betreust unseren Shop im Alltag, bereitest Aktionen vor und entwickelst unsere Inhalte und Angebote mit weiter. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Marketingteam und externen Partnern zusammen.

Aufgaben

  • Du pflegst unseren Onlineshop und hältst Produkte, Texte, Bilder und Preise aktuell.
  • Du bereitest neue Produkte, Verkaufsaktionen und Kampagnen vor.
  • Du erstellst und aktualisierst Shop-Seiten, Produktpakete und Aktionsangebote.
  • Du prüfst, ob Inhalte, Links und die Darstellung auf Handy und Desktop passen.
  • Du erstellst und überarbeitest Inhalte wie Blogbeiträge, Ratgeber und Produkttexte.
  • Du unterstützt Projekte, mit denen wir Bestandskunden zurückgewinnen und die Kundenbindung stärken.
  • Du behältst Termine im Blick und wertest gemeinsam mit dem Team aus, was gut funktioniert.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung im E-Commerce und bereits mit einem Shopsystem gearbeitet.
  • Du kannst Aufgaben selbstständig organisieren und zuverlässig abschließen.
  • Du schreibst verständliche Texte und hast ein gutes Auge für Gestaltung.
  • Du findest dich schnell in digitalen Tools zurecht und arbeitest sorgfältig.
  • Du kommunizierst klar
